title: 宋定伯卖鬼
title_en: The Boy Who Sold a Ghost
blurb_en: A young man meets a ghost on a dark road and tells it he is a ghost too.
blurb_zh: 夜里赶路碰到鬼，怎么办？宋定伯说：“真巧，我也是鬼。”
